name: English Literature
notes: The department offers four minors (creative writing, English literature, journalism, theater). This entry is the English Literature minor; creative writing and journalism are encoded separately as minor-engl-creative-writing and minor-engl-journalism.
The theater minor is NOT encoded: it is specified in credits against THTR course numbers introduced in Summer 2026, and the harvested 2025-26 catalog contains no THTR courses to match against.
All four minors require a minimum of six courses, five of which must be taken while at the University of Rochester.
No more than two courses in one's major may overlap with the minor.
Students majoring in one English track may minor in another area - literature majors may minor in creative writing, journalism, or theater.
